ticket.subject: Charged twice this month
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

Writing on behalf of Glimmerbrook BV. We were charged twice for our Team subscription this month: two payments of €149.00 went through on Monday, a few minutes apart.

Invoice INV-2026-2199 only lists one payment, so the second charge looks like a mistake. Honestly, this is really frustrating.

This is blocking us right now, so we need help today. Please refund the duplicate payment and confirm once it is done.

Regards,
Hanna

label_notes: clean billing (billing-double-charge): a double charge is P2 in the guide; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
